snippet.title: Irreversible - Gameplay Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Irreversible is an immersive single-player VR narrative-driven adventure featuring branching dialogues, exploration of uncanny desert mysteries and shooter elements. Communicate via radio with your colleague Anna and face off against the local fauna in your struggle to make your way back home.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3215560/Irreversible/
Discord: https://discord.gg/nJXJ9HNhJH

Press Kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1M7JlNztRt3sRLuf4g9oWTNsW-NwD3M0K?usp=sharing
